crossRefs.note: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and…
But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

translations.web: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.
translations.bsb: And they spent a long time there with the disciples.
translations.kjv: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
translations.asv: And they tarried no little time with the disciples.
